title: ConformanceProfile
description: Input to conformance/run.py: how to invoke a CLI and which probes to run against it.

tool.description: Display name of the CLI under test.

command.description: Invocation prefix. A first element containing a slash resolves against the profile's directory; a bare name resolves through PATH.

timeout_seconds.description: Per-run limit. A run that exceeds it is killed and counts as a hang.

manifest.description: Arguments after the prefix that print the manifest. Omit when the CLI has none; manifest_valid is then skipped.

argument_order.description: One read invocation and a global option to move around it. Omit to skip argument_order.

probes.description: Invocations to run. Include at least one read probe; add invalid, destructive, and stream probes to enable those checks.

command_path.description: Command path of a side-effect-free command, such as ["deployments", "list"].

local_args.description: A command-local option and its value, such as ["--limit", "5"]. The kit places it before and after the global option.

global_flag.description: Long name of a global option, usually --format.

value.description: Value that makes stdout a ResponseEnvelope, usually json.

alternate_value.description: Another accepted value whose stdout differs from value's, such as plain. Detects a value overwritten by a subcommand default.

positional.description: A positional argument command_path accepts. The kit then places local_args after it, and local_args must change the result.

argv.description: Arguments after the command prefix. Never include confirmation flags such as --yes.

kind.description: read: side-effect free. destructive: expected to refuse without confirmation. invalid: expected to exit 2. stream: a side-effect-free command whose stdout is a JSONL stream (REQ-O-004).

dry_run_flag.description: Flag appended to preview a destructive probe. Required when kind is destructive; not allowed when kind is stream.

deadline_seconds.description: Stream probes only: limit for the whole stream, from start to exit. Defaults to timeout_seconds. A stream still running at the deadline is killed and fails.

signal.description: Stream probes only: signal sent to the process after after_lines lines of stdout. Requires after_lines.

after_lines.description: Stream probes only: number of stdout lines read before the kit sends signal. Requires signal.
